findings.text: The task assumes that any remaining foreign-key violation makes a write fail, but SQLite permits unrelated writes after violations were inserted with enforcement off. Fix: specify checks on affected keys and add a case that enables enforcement over existing violations.

The task requires every write involving a malformed foreign key to fail preparation, but SQLite permits parent inserts and child updates that leave foreign-key columns untouched, as its [documentation](https://www.sqlite.org/foreignkeys.html) explains. Fix: limit prepare errors to operations that use the affected foreign key and test the permitted writes.
